flags.detail: Option D ('Animals reappeared far sooner after release than the model said they should') is asserted as TRUE by the transcript, not contradicted: 'A dozen did reappear within days of release, sooner than the model allows; too few to move the model.' The only thing that disqualifies D is the five-word tail 'too few to move the model' combined with the stem's narrow phrase 'about the population estimate'. A listener hearing this once has heard a recapture-figure finding stated in the professor's own words and can reasonably choose it; the refutation is a relevance distinction, not an incompatible assertion.

Option B ('Stations the books list under a single name turn out to have moved between crews') is never refuted — it is stated as fact, and stated AFTER the 'What he found instead:' marker that is supposed to fence the key off: 'What he found instead: after each dredging the channel fills quickest through the first winter, then slackens off. Two stations had moved between crews, and Ordwell renamed them before plotting.' Both sentences sit inside Ordwell's replotting work; the only separation is that Ordwell handled the station problem ('renamed them before plotting') rather than reporting it as a result. That is rhetorical framing, not incompatibility — the same defect shape flagged in the previous batch.

The stem asks 'How does the professor respond to Polgrenna's suggestion', but the transcript voices no response at all — the paragraph after 'Polgrenna's second breeding site.' is three bare facts with no stance verb, no 'I doubt it', no 'I resist that'. The key C ('He resists it, since the young arrive in one short pulse rather than in scattered waves') rests on the span 'The young come in one short pulse, ten days and done', and the inference one-pulse-therefore-one-source is nowhere licensed by the transcript. C survives only because A, B and D are each hard-killed by explicit contradictions ('the pulse falls in the low-water weeks'; 'in wet years and dry ones alike'; 'Eggs turn up in the known pools a fortnight before the first young appear'). The listener must reconstruct the professor's position by elimination rather than hear it.
